metric_notes.models: Exactly four Ollama models are used; no fifth model is required.
metric_notes.peer_evaluation: Each candidate is judged by the other three models, never by its own generator model.
metric_notes.aggregation: Claim labels use majority vote; numeric evaluation scores use the mean of the three peer judgments.
metric_notes.reference_metrics: ROUGE, BLEU and optional BERTScore are calculated only when a separate human/reference summary is supplied; they are not part of the selection score.
metric_notes.omitted_claims: Omitted claims are tracked separately and are not counted as hallucinations.
metric_notes.recall_at_k: Unavailable until actual relevant/retrieved evidence IDs are connected from the retriever.
metric_notes.research_caution: Peer LLM judgments are model-based estimates, not ground truth. Manually audit a sample of claims and report agreement where possible.
